data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-l-l', meaning 'to rise, bloom, or flourish'. This name evokes images of growth, renewal, and beauty. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haala usually hope their child will grow to embody blooming, flourishing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
